title: Revealing the details of how OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face
summary: A Hacker News discussion (521 points, 331 comments) about an article on swarmtraces.org titled 'Revealing the details of how OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face.' The piece examines a security incident involving OpenAI agents targeting Hugging Face infrastructure, with commenters debating the technical mechanics, agent autonomy, and security implications of the reported exploit.
